name: qf_bike
character: A single-cylinder 155 cc sport bike followed from behind: one firing pulse per two revolutions through a short exhaust, its pitch following the rpm through six gears, a gap and a dip on every upshift, a blip and a burble on every downshift, and the valvetrain behind it.
note: f0 is the firing frequency rpm x 1 / 120 (11.67 Hz at 1400 rpm idle, 87.5 Hz at the 10500 limit); the pitch curve is rpm / idle rpm through the gears of timeline.hero_bike (a shift multiplies the rpm by the ratio of the new gear to the old, with a 90 ms power gap on an upshift and a 120 ms blip on a downshift). Gear ratios are one listing's six-speed set. ESTIMATE: the exhaust and intake formants, the gain curves and every level are starting values; the rev limiter (10,500 rpm) and the idle (1,400 rpm) are estimates (no source gave them); no recording of a bike was analysed
